ryogoku.name: Ryogoku Kokugikan
ryogoku.description: Sumo's spiritual home, in the Ryogoku district of Tokyo. Hosts three of the six annual honbasho: January, May and September.

edion-osaka.name: EDION Arena Osaka
edion-osaka.nameJa: エディオンアリーナ大阪
edion-osaka.description: Host of the March Haru Basho, in the heart of Namba, Osaka.

ig-arena.name: IG Arena
ig-arena.description: The brand-new Aichi International Arena, designed by Kengo Kuma, hosting the July Nagoya Basho with full climate control.

fukuoka.name: Fukuoka Kokusai Center
fukuoka.description: Host of the November Kyushu Basho, the final tournament of the sumo year.
